decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app is promoted as a new product line close to the core practice software, its value under digitalization is still unfolding, and carrying it costs little, so the option is worth keeping.
The continuing education institute builds on existing training content and customer relationships at modest cost, and its uncertain but complementary value justifies keeping the option open.
The remote screen-sharing support tool is a low-cost complement to the firm's customer support with no evidence of failure, so keeping it is cheaper than giving up the option.
